facts.text: Cerealia Facula Salt Caldera was deployed at Ceres & Vesta — Perpetual Orbit during Dawn in 2007.
Luminous sodium carbonate hydrothermal salt deposits inside Occator Crater, formed by brine erupting from a subterranean slush reservoir.
Engineered specifically to operate in the harsh vacuum and extreme temperatures of the lunar environment.
Proved Ceres is a geologically active relic ocean world with lingering subsurface brine pockets and cryovolcanic activity.
Status: Remains preserved in the arid regolith at Ceres & Vesta — Perpetual Orbit.
Redefined dwarf planets as living geochemical laboratories rather than frozen dead rocks.
